description: Find books by `query`: exact title, author, ISBN, tag, or Calibre query syntax (mode=meta), or full text (mode=fts). mode=fts words match independently and stemmed (events matches event); wrap a phrase in double quotes for an exact match ("event sourcing"); supports AND/OR/NOT between terms (uppercase, e.g. a NOT b). scope=book returns short keyword snippets from inside one book; first hits often land in TOC/front matter — for definitional or topic questions within a book prefer calibre_semantic_search scope=book (ranked passages with char offsets). Use calibre_semantic_search for meaning/topic queries. For "how many" questions use countOnly=true (returns only the count). filter accepts a bundle name to scope the search (list bundles via calibre_manage_bundles). Calibre 9.18+: mode=annotations searches highlights, their notes and bookmark titles (filter applies; scope=book + bookId searches one book, query "*" lists all its annotations); mode=notes searches notes attached to authors, series, tags, publisher (filters do not apply), and query "authors:Name" (or series:/tags:/publisher:/#custom:, item may be quoted) shows the whole note of that item.
name: calibre_search
title: Search books
